headline: At least six clubs say their fans' data was taken; they say it was contact and ID details, not passwords or bank data.
summary: Added club statements (Getafe CF, Real Oviedo, Girona FC, Albacete Balompié, Real Zaragoza: Tier 1), Cadena SER on CD Eldense's statement, The Record and Marca (Tier 2). New c008 clubs affected: Confirmed (club statements). New c009 data types per LALIGA via clubs: Reported. New c010 Eldense says LALIGA learned of it Nov 18, against Reuters' Nov 16: Reported. Updated c003 (origin of access identified but not disclosed; date conflict), c005 (clubs' own AEPD notices, Getafe police complaint), c006 (still no count), c007 (The Record: no group linked, ransomware unclear). Real Zaragoza's statement does not say its fans are affected, though The Record lists it. No AEPD or police statement found. Main answer unchanged. Privacy check done.

headline: LALIGA says an attacker extracted fan data from a platform on Nov 14 to 16. Confirmed by its statement; scale and cause unknown.
summary: New incident page. Sources read: LALIGA's own statement (Tier 1), Reuters via CNA and Europa Press (Tier 2, both relaying that one statement, counted as one source). Cyberattack and data extraction: Confirmed. Dates, containment, regulator and police notices, and scope limits: Reported (company only). Count, data types, attacker and method: Not established. Root cause not published. Privacy check done: no names, handles or contact details.
